wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is entirely blank - a real empty schedule, zero rows. Cover line 1 carries a large hand-drawn circle (a written zero) in ALL THREE columns, so 0 rows == 0.00 on both scopes; they coincide (LAST REPORT is also 0, i.e. this is the first report of the cycle). Cover line 2 (<=$50 aggregate) is likewise 0 in all three columns, so no un-itemized small-donor money is hidden here.

expenditures.detail: Three Form B rows sum 40.00+20.00+300.00 = 360.00, equal to cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST = 0), so the scopes coincide. All four amounts (three rows plus the cover figure) are written as whole dollars with a trailing dash meaning no cents. This is also the arithmetic that settles the first row's glyph: it is 40, not 46 or 76 - 40+20+300 is the only reading that closes to the printed 360.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr form prints no schedule total or page subtotal on either schedule; the filer wrote none either. Cover line 3 (360-) is the only anchor for Form B and it equals the row sum 360.00. Cover line 1 (0) is the only anchor for Form A and matches its zero rows.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3: geometry ok, 39 data bands; 3 inked writing bands (1-3), no filer total band = 3 rows emitted. p2 read at 90 and 200 dpi: no ink anywhere in the grid = 0 rows.
gates.geometry_proof: p3: a single 1000 dpi crop of the amount column spanning bands 1-3 renders '40-', '20-', '300-' in that order (first and last row both present and in position); the control crop one pitch below band 3 renders empty.
gates.balance_chain: 0 + 0 - 360.00 = -360.00, but cover line 4 prints '360-' (positive) in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. FILER ARITHMETIC / SIGN ERROR, retained verbatim - the magnitude closes, the sign does not. Not a transcription defect: the digits are unambiguous at 600 dpi.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crop of the cover anchor block; 1000 dpi crop of the p3 amount column (bands 1-3) plus its control band; 800 dpi crop of the p3 date column.
notes: index.csv calls the candidate Leslie P. Larson / office County Council; the cover reads 'Leslie P Larson' and 'Name of Office: County Council', 'Office District: South' - agrees, in scope. All three Form B dates are written MONTH/YEAR ONLY ('03/08', '04/08', '04/08') with no day, so every date field is left BLANK with needs_review=1 and the verbatim kept in the row note - no day was invented. Cover PO box, home city, home and business phone numbers discarded at read time. Clerk date stamp reads 2008 JUL 17.

expenditures.note: date cell reads '03/08' - month and year only, no day, so the date is left blank per contract. Amount written '40' with a trailing dash meaning no cents -> 40.00. The leading glyph is a bistable open-top 4; the schedule sum (40+20+300=360) closing to the printed cover figure 360 is what settles it as 4, not the glyph read.

date cell reads '04/08' - month and year only, no day, left blank per contract. Amount written '20' with a trailing dash meaning no cents -> 20.00; the leading 2 is written with a looped descender that could read 7, and again the schedule sum decides it is 2.

date cell reads '04/08' - month and year only, no day, left blank per contract. Vendor glyphs read 'Square O_l' with the second word ambiguous between 'One' and 'Oil'; transcribed as the legible-glyph string 'Square One' at low confidence rather than a plausible business name. Amount written '300' with a trailing dash meaning no cents -> 300.00.
